plan.target: Address Decoding Indexing Bug in mhpmevent CSR Writes (src/privileged/csrc.sv)
plan.rationale:
Under the RISC-V Instruction Set Manual, Volume II: Privileged Architecture (v20211203 and v20240411, Section 3.1.11 'Machine Hardware Performance Monitor (MHPM)' and Table 3.5 'Machine-mode CSRs'), the event selector CSRs `mhpmevent3` through `mhpmevent31` are mapped to contiguous CSR addresses `0x323` through `0x33F`. In Wally's counter CSR unit (`src/privileged/csrc.sv`), `localparam MHPMEVENTBASE = 12'h323;` is defined as the address of `mhpmevent3`. In lines 160-168, the write enable decoding is implemented as:
```systemverilog
if (P.COUNTERS > 3) begin : mhpmeventgen
  for (i = 3; i < P.COUNTERS; i = i+1) begin : mhpmevent
    assign WriteMHPMEVENTM[i] = CSRMWriteM & (CSRAdrM == MHPMEVENTBASE + i);
    assign NextMHPMEVENTM[i] = WriteMHPMEVENTM[i] ? CSRWriteValM : MHPMEVENT_REGW[i];
    always_ff @(posedge clk)
      if (reset) MHPMEVENT_REGW[i] <= '0;
      else       MHPMEVENT_REGW[i] <= NextMHPMEVENTM[i];
  end
end
```
In line 162, `CSRAdrM == MHPMEVENTBASE + i` improperly adds loop index `i` (which starts at 3) to `MHPMEVENTBASE` (which is already `12'h323`), introducing an off-by-3 address error for every event selector register:
- For `i = 3` (`mhpmevent3`), it decodes `0x323 + 3 = 0x326` (`mhpmevent6`).
- For `i = 4` (`mhpmevent4`), it decodes `0x323 + 4 = 0x327` (`mhpmevent7`).
Consequently, an architectural write to `mhpmevent3` (`csrw 0x323, <val>`) never asserts `WriteMHPMEVENTM[3]`, and `MHPMEVENT_REGW[3]` permanently remains 0. When reading back `mhpmevent3` at `0x323`, line 181 (`CSRCReadValM = MHPMEVENT_REGW[CounterNumM]`) indexes `CounterNumM = 3`, returning 0. Furthermore, writing to CSR `0x326` (`mhpmevent6`) erroneously asserts `WriteMHPMEVENTM[3]`, corrupting `mhpmevent3` from an unrelated CSR address. In addition, because line 144 gates `CounterInc[i]` with `(MHPMEVENT_REGW[i] != 0)`, `mhpmcounter3` can never increment when configured via standard writes to `mhpmevent3`.
plan.tester_prompt:
You are Agent 2, Tester. Investigate and build a deterministic reproducer for the address decoding bug in Wally's `mhpmevent` CSR writes.

### 1. Defect Analysis & Targeted RTL
- **File**: `src/privileged/csrc.sv`
- **Defect Line**: Line 162
  ```systemverilog
  localparam MHPMEVENTBASE = 12'h323;
  ...
  for (i = 3; i < P.COUNTERS; i = i+1) begin : mhpmevent
    assign WriteMHPMEVENTM[i] = CSRMWriteM & (CSRAdrM == MHPMEVENTBASE + i);
  ```
  `MHPMEVENTBASE` is `12'h323` (the address of `mhpmevent3`). Because `i` begins at 3, `MHPMEVENTBASE + i` evaluates to `0x326` for `i = 3`, `0x327` for `i = 4`, etc. As a result:
  1. Writing to `mhpmevent3` (CSR 0x323) never asserts `WriteMHPMEVENTM[3]`, leaving `MHPMEVENT_REGW[3]` stuck at 0. A subsequent `csrr` of `mhpmevent3` returns 0.
  2. Writing to `mhpmevent6` (CSR 0x326) mistakenly matches `i = 3` and updates `MHPMEVENT_REGW[3]`.
  3. `mhpmcounter3` never increments under normal configuration because `CounterInc[3]` requires `(MHPMEVENT_REGW[3] != 0)` (line 144).

### 2. Supported Configuration & Prebuilt Simulators
- **Configurations**: Standard `rv64gc` (`P.COUNTERS = 32`) or `counters5_rv64gc` (`P.COUNTERS = 5`).
- **Prebuilt Verilator binary**: `sim/verilator/wkdir/rv64gc_testbench/Vtestbench` is pre-compiled and available in the shared worktree.

### 3. Normative Specification References
- **RISC-V Instruction Set Manual, Volume II: Privileged Architecture** (v20211203 & v20240411):
  - Section 3.1.11 ('Machine Hardware Performance Monitor (MHPM)'): `mhpmevent3` through `mhpmevent31` are event-selector registers that control which event causes the corresponding counter to increment.
  - Table 3.5 ('Machine-mode CSRs'): `mhpmevent3` is mapped to CSR address `0x323`, `mhpmevent4` to `0x324`, ..., `mhpmevent31` to `0x33F`.
  - Writing to `mhpmevent3` (0x323) must update `mhpmevent3` and read back the written value. Writing to `0x326` (`mhpmevent6`) must not overwrite `mhpmevent3`.

### 4. Test Suite Requirements (`$test_dir/tests/`)
Write self-checking assembly tests in `$test_dir/tests/`:
1. `test_mhpmevent_write.S` (Primary Bug Trigger):
   - Set `mtvec` to `fail` handler (`fail: csrw mtvec, x0; jr x0`).
   - Write `0x55` to `mhpmevent3` (CSR `0x323`):
     ```assembly
     li t0, 0x55
     csrw 0x323, t0
     csrr t1, 0x323
     bne t1, t0, fail
     ```
   - In buggy Wally DUT: `t1` reads back 0, branching to `fail` and triggering a Watch Dog Time Out / illegal fetch at address 0 (exit code 134).
   - In fixed Wally DUT: `t1` reads back `0x55`, proceeding cleanly to `pass`.
2. `test_mhpmevent_cross.S` (Cross-Address Defect Confirmation):
   - Write `0xAA` to `mhpmevent6` (CSR `0x326`):
     ```assembly
     li t2, 0xAA
     csrw 0x326, t2
     csrr t3, 0x323
     beq t3, t2, fail
     ```
   - In buggy Wally DUT: writing to `0x326` overwrites `MHPMEVENT_REGW[3]`, so reading `0x323` returns `0xAA`, jumping to `fail`.
3. `test_positive_control.S` (Control Test):
   - Execute normal instructions and confirm baseline execution passes.

### 5. Linker and Testbench Conventions
- Compile with `/home/rafay/riscv/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc -march=rv64gc -mabi=lp64d -nostdlib -nostartfiles -T $WALLY/tests/riscof/spike/env/link.ld`.
- Ensure section `.tohost, "aw", @progbits` is defined with 64-byte alignment.
- Pass handler:
  ```assembly
  pass:
    la t0, tohost
    li t1, 1
    sd t1, 0(t0)
  1: j 1b
  ```
  (Wally testbench terminates upon executing self-loop `1: j 1b` (`0x0000006f`)).
- Fail handler:
  ```assembly
  fail:
    csrw mtvec, x0
    jr x0
  ```

### 6. Reproducer Script Contract (`$test_dir/reproducer.sh`)
- Rebuild against `$WALLY/src` if any source files are patched, or reuse the prebuilt `Vtestbench`.
- Run Wally DUT:
  `./sim/verilator/wkdir/rv64gc_testbench/Vtestbench +ElfFile=$test_dir/build/test_mhpmevent_write.elf > $test_dir/logs/wally.log 2>&1`
- Check exit code and log:
  - Exit 1: Bug confirmed (DUT fails with code 134 or 'Watch Dog Time Out' / illegal instruction fault at PC 0).
  - Exit 0: All tests pass with exit code 0 (correct/fixed behavior).
  - Exit 2: Build, tool, or syntax error.
- Strictly isolate all outputs to `$test_dir/build/` and `$test_dir/logs/`. Write `$test_dir/README.md` detailing the test execution.

1. Source Files & RTL Logic Analyzed:
   - `src/privileged/csrc.sv`:
     - Line 76: `localparam MHPMEVENTBASE = 12'h323;` sets the base address of `mhpmevent3`.
     - Line 162: `assign WriteMHPMEVENTM[i] = CSRMWriteM & (CSRAdrM == MHPMEVENTBASE + i);` loops over `i = 3..P.COUNTERS-1`. For `i = 3`, `MHPMEVENTBASE + 3 = 0x326` instead of `0x323`, shifting the write address of every `mhpmevent` register by +3.
     - Line 181: Read logic `if (CSRAdrM < MHPMEVENTBASE+P.COUNTERS-3) CSRCReadValM = MHPMEVENT_REGW[CounterNumM];` correctly indexes `CounterNumM = CSRAdrM[4:0] = 3` for address `0x323`. Because writes to `0x323` were ignored by line 162, readback yields 0.
     - Line 144: `CounterInc[i] = CounterEvent[i] & ~MCOUNTINHIBIT_REGW[i] & (MHPMEVENT_REGW[i] != 0);` requires `MHPMEVENT_REGW[i] != 0` for `mhpmcounter<i>` to count events; since `MHPMEVENT_REGW[3]` is unwritable at `0x323`, `mhpmcounter3` remains permanently frozen.
   - `src/privileged/csrm.sv`:
     - Lines 107-108: `COUNTERINHIBIT_MASK` and `COUNTEREN_MASK` mask `mcountinhibit` and `mcounteren`.
   - `src/ieu/regfile.sv` & `src/ieu/datapath.sv`:
     - Verified `amocas` paired register access semantics.
   - `src/ifu/decompress.sv` & `src/ieu/controller.sv`:
     - Analyzed `c.mop.n` and `mop.r.n` decoding under Zimop/Zcmop.

Reading back `0x323` returned `0` after the first write (proving write to `0x323` was dropped) and `0xAA` after the write to `0x326` (proving cross-write into `mhpmevent3`), triggering a Watch Dog Time Out abort.
